label.purpose: Uppercase tracked field labels for scan rhythm.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted ink-stone CTA for save and confirm actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1c1917; color: #f7f2ea; font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d97706; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #e7e5e4; color: #78716c; opacity: 0.7; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined ghost for secondary paths like camera roll.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #1c1917; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #1c1917; font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d97706; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent FAB
components.description: Floating action button for add review or open camera.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Add Review"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4L16.5 3.5z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #d97706; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.1); transition: transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-fab:hover { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1917; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Large bold input for restaurant name capture.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Where did you eat?" />
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 58px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 18px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a8a29e; font-weight: 700; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #d97706; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Review Card
components.description: List card for a saved restaurant verdict.
components.html:
Tartine Manufactory
595 Alabama St, San Francisco
Will visit again
May 18
components.css: .ds-review-card { padding: 16px; border-radius: 22px; background: #ffffff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-review-card__title { font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #1c1917; } .ds-review-card__address { font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #78716c; } .ds-review-card__verdict { font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #57534e; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-review-card__date { font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #78716c; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.3px; }

components.name: Rating Selector
components.description: Segmented verdict picker inside a field container.
components.css: .ds-rating-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 18px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-rating-option { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: #1c1917; font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: capitalize; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-rating-option--selected { background: #d97706; border-color: #d97706; color: #ffffff; } .ds-rating-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d97706; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Pill
components.description: Floating tab bar for Reviews and Photos.
components.css: .ds-tab-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(231, 229, 228, 0.1); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.1); } .ds-tab-pill__item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-tab-pill__item span { font-family: 'Spline Sans', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #57534e; } .ds-tab-pill__item--active span { color: #d97706; } .ds-tab-pill__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d97706; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview: JuiceColored Dash is a field notebook that lives in your pocket: warm stone surfaces, one amber accent, and iOS-native structure borrowed from Apple Notes. The visual system serves capture speed, not brand theater. Personality stays on juicecolored.com; here, design gets out of the way so you can log a place, pick a verdict, or snap a cutout before the moment passes.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone neutrals with a single amber accent used for selection and FAB only
Large iOS titles, uppercase tracked labels, bold input text for quick scanning
Continuous rounded corners at 18–32px; full pills for primary actions
Tonal depth via background/field contrast; shadows reserved for floating chrome
Direct, utilitarian copy tone reflected in restrained visual hierarchy

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on active/selected states and the FAB. If more than ~10% of a screen reads amber, you've over-applied it.

rules.name: The Inverted Primary Rule
rules.body: Primary CTAs use ink-stone fill with cream text, not amber. Amber is for selection; ink is for action.

rules.name: The Bold Input Rule
rules.body: Form inputs render at 22px bold. Users are typing place names in a hurry; small body text is wrong here.

rules.name: The Tracked Label Rule
rules.body: Section labels are always uppercase with letter-spacing ≥1.3px. Sentence-case labels read as body copy and break scan rhythm.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Never add box-shadow to cards or inputs. If something needs to feel raised, use the field surface color on a background canvas.

dos: Do use warm cream background + field white cards for every screen; tonal layering is the default depth model.
Do apply continuous border curves on all rounded React Native views.
Do keep amber for selection states and the FAB only; use ink-stone inverted buttons for primary actions.
Do write uppercase tracked labels for field grouping and direct verdict language.
Do honor system light/dark mode via useColorScheme and the shared getAppColors token map.
donts: Don't use star ratings, likes, follower counts, or any Yelp/Beli/Google Maps social review patterns.
Don't add calorie counts, macro rings, diet framing, or health-dashboard chrome from calorie tracker apps.
Don't ship dark SaaS dashboards, purple gradients, or generic productivity UI chrome.
Don't import web portfolio theatrics: glass cards, gradient text, hero metrics, decorative blur.
Don't add box-shadow to cards or inputs; shadows are for floating tab bar and FAB only.
Don't use side-stripe colored borders on list items or cards.
